crossRefs.note: “ ‘All flying insects that walk on all fours are an abomination to you.
But all winged creeping things which have four feet are an abomination to you.
“ ‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any…

translations.web: “ ‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
translations.bsb: Every creature that moves along the ground is detestable; it must not be eaten.
translations.kjv: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
translations.asv: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth is an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
